fact: The e-Government Authority (e-GA) says its Msaada AI system is in use by the Tanzania Tourist Board on its website and by the President's Office Public Service Management in its e-Mrejesho system.
The e-Government Authority says Msaada AI is used by two institutions, the Tanzania Tourist Board and the President's Office Public Service Management.
The World Bank says Tanzania's procurement regulator PPRA runs NeST, its e-procurement system, which is powered by AI and applies AI-driven red flags across the procurement cycle.
Maxbit says it won a contract, worth $35 million over ten years, with the Zanzibar e-Government Authority (eGAZ) for its AI-integrated Origami platform to deliver government services.
